name: MANGO
description: MANGO is a benchmark to evaluate large language models' abilities in text-based mapping and navigation. It consists of 53 mazes paired with walkthroughs and hundreds of questions testing navigation and spatial reasoning.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for text-based navigation and spatial reasoning in LLMs, with limited but growing use in research.
notes: Includes 53 mazes from textgames with walkthroughs; tests mapping and navigation questions; shows GPT-4 struggles on this task.
